_about: Spec 13 bag-family presentation data (ported from INVUI's inv_ui.json, trimmed to what canon reads). attribute_classes: the gold (positive) and grey (negative) material traits of spec 04 lines 8-10; the green rare traits are NOT listed here, they are rules.json crafting.rare_attributes (Crafting.rare_attributes), so one list feeds crafting, gathering and the card. Keys not classed here or there (tint, hardness, material_tier, quality, look, ...) never show as traits. Read by InvAttributes, InvStats and GearPresets.

presets._about: Character -> Gear numbered loadouts (spec 13 s14). A preset opens at a shown player level. ASSUMPTION (INVUI's): 4 presets at levels 1, 10, 30, 50; the PRDs give no number.

powers._about: Character panel power rows = the highest skill level in each group's trees (SkillState, 1-60). ASSUMPTION (INVUI's design assumption 10).
